title: K Scan AI Closet — machine-readable contract
description: The canonical shape of an owned Closet item and of the deterministic intelligence derived from a Closet. Generated from source truth: services/closetLibrary.js (CLOSET_ITEM_TAXONOMY_FIELDS and buildClosetRecord), services/closetItemProjection.ts (the read projection) and services/closet/closetIntelligence.ts. THIS FILE IS THE PROGRAM BRIDGE (section 19): downstream evaluation instruments validate their Closet fixtures against it, so a fixture cannot silently stop describing a real Closet. It contains no invented or future field.

closetItem.description: One owned Closet item, as a screen or a downstream consumer may read it. Ownership is created ONLY by an explicit user action through createClosetItem; scanning, saving, viewing, a purchase link, a Dressing Room, Virtual Try-On, the Watchlist and an Elise conversation never create one.

id.description: Device-local stable id. Reused as the cloud sync idempotency key (user_closet_items.client_id). Never regenerated.

title.description: Display label. Defaults to the literal 'Closet item' when no name was supplied. A DISPLAY STRING ONLY: nothing may parse it to recover taxonomy.

origin.description: How the user put this item in the Closet. NOT an ownership qualifier — both values are owned items.

createdAt.description: When the CLOSET RECORD was created. This is NOT a purchase date and must never be presented as one.

displaySummary.description: Derived: category, type, subtype and colour joined, de-duplicated. Presentation only.

taxonomyUnknown.description: True when the record carries no structured taxonomy at all. Distinguishes 'this build does not store brands' from 'this garment has no brand'.

meetsFilterFloor.description: True when coverage is at or above 70% — the floor at which a field may be exposed as a primary filter.

closetIntelligence.description: Deterministic facts about the items RECORDED IN K SCAN AI. Never a claim about the user's complete physical wardrobe, purchase behaviour, fit, spending or revenue.

unclassifiedItems.description: Records carrying no structured taxonomy at all (taxonomyUnknown).

uncategorizedItems.description: Records with NO CATEGORY. Distinct from unclassifiedItems, and it is this one licensesAbsenceClaims depends on: an item can carry a colour and a size (so it is not taxonomy-unknown) while still having no category, and categoryCounts is keyed on category alone.

duplicateCandidates.description: Exact stable product identity only. Fuzzy title similarity, image similarity, perceptual hashing and colour similarity are forbidden. Always empty in V1 — a Closet record carries no product id, SKU or GTIN.

licensesAbsenceClaims.description: May a consumer read a MISSING category key as 'the user owns none of these'? False whenever any record has no category. Absence of classification is not classification of absence. Mirrors censusLicensesAbsenceClaims in supabase/functions/stylechat-generate/eliseClosetCensus.ts.
